summary: Emiratisation Hub is a UAE-based specialist platform helping businesses meet their Emiratisation (Nafis) targets through compliant talent recruitment, workforce compliance advisory, and strategic support. We connect employers with qualified Emirati candidates and guide companies through MOHRE regulations, quota management, and government incentive programmes.
details: Emiratisation Hub serves private-sector companies of all sizes operating in the UAE who are required to meet Emiratisation quotas under the Nafis initiative. Our services span Emirati talent sourcing, compliance gap analysis, Nafis enrolment support, and ongoing strategic advisory to help employers maintain compliance and benefit from government incentive programmes.
blogNote: The Emiratisation Hub blog covers Emiratisation regulations, Nafis programme updates, workforce compliance, and Emirati talent market insights.
